# Private Military Companies
Not every soldier on the frontier serves a nation. Private military companies sell their services to whoever pays.
- [bold]Weyland-Yutani PMC[/bold]: see [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"]. - [bold]Prodigy Corporation Security Forces[/bold]: former military personnel, former police and hired mercenaries, contracted out by the Prodigy Corporation to whichever faction pays the most. - [bold]Vanguard Arrow Inc, Primary Operations[/bold] (VAIPO): a United States-based security firm made up of former UA forces and veterans, specializing in protecting high-value targets and assets and in rapid response.
